generation_rules: Validate resolved age as at least 18 before any art or dialogue generation.
Use the default 18–24 age range for most generated companions; any older exception remains explicitly adult.
Resolve background, equipment, perk and encounter from a compatible authored package.
Use curated adult characterization and PG-13 wardrobe; no child-coded presentation.
Keep recruitment, relationship, party role, perks and madness separate.
Assign a madness record to every generated character, including non-companions.
Persist final identity and seed; never reroll a saved person on load.
Validate the fully resolved record with companion.schema.json.
Prioritize mutual attraction and a short unique adventure played as the companion; avoid begging, repeated refusals and endless dialogue.
Resolve a compatible playable skill, protagonist support role and brief affectionate payoff for each companion adventure.
Treat rebellious PG-13 clothing as personal expression rather than the character's entire identity.
procedural_template.roster_scale_decision: Dan, 2026-09-10: a large romance roster (hundreds over time) is the accepted direction, resolving the 'Roster and deployment limits' question this template previously left open. The mechanism for reaching that scale is this procedural generator plus continued hand-authored named companions (see named_characters above), not hundreds of individually bespoke companion.schema.json records authored one at a time -- see design/decisions.json's 'roster_scale' entry for the full reasoning, including the real ceiling this hits today (96 extracted, zero admitted, art candidates in kits/character-families/catalog.json).
